title: Washio: on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning pickup by app

source.text: Washio: on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning pickup and delivery ordered by app, launch country US. Score it as of 2013-06-01: use only evidence published on or before that date (set verdict.as_of). Founder: a seed-funded startup. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug washio.

problem: Doing laundry and getting to a dry cleaner during opening hours takes time busy urban people don't have.
solution: A smartphone app to order on-demand pickup and delivery of laundry and dry cleaning.
claims: on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning pickup and delivery ordered by app
assumptions: Founder is a seed-funded team (stated); budget assumed to be a typical 2013 seed round, about USD 0.5-1.5M.
Launch city assumed to be Los Angeles; target customer assumed to be urban professionals without in-unit washers.
Operating model assumed outsourced: partner cleaners do the cleaning, contractor drivers do pickup and delivery.
Price assumed $1.75/lb wash & fold, 15-lb orders, $0.85/lb wholesale, 0.5 driver-hour per order (no dated 2012 LA prices found).
Scored as of 2013-06-01 with no questions asked (headless run): sources published after that date were excluded.
